subject: Coordination: pick a demo slot + loop ops and security

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Quick sync — pick a 15–30m demo window and ops intro

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — really useful to understand MedLytics' three-pronged priority for Q2 (low-latency inference, tighter cost controls, and an audit trail for model usage). As discussed, the best next step is a short technical demo that shows:
- a 15-min demo of a model serving flow for inference at scale,
- 10 min for SSO and security controls, and
- 5 min for procurement/contract Qs.

Can you pick one of these windows (we'll provide a calendar invite once you confirm):
- Tue 23 Mar, 10:00–10:30 ET
- Wed 24 Mar, 14:00–14:30 ET
- Thu 25 Mar, 09:00–09:30 ET

If procurement or security need to be on the call, please loop them in — happy to shift timing. I’ve copied Marissa (solutions lead) and Karthik (platform) so they can run the demo and answer SSO/ops questions.

Attachments: medlytics-ma-outline.pdf (one-page mutual action plan stub)

Next steps: confirm a slot, and if you can share preferred attendees for procurement/security I’ll add them to the invite.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
